atAGlance: Mì xào hải sản is stir-fried noodles with seafood, usually with shrimp, squid, greens, garlic, and fish-sauce-and-garlic glaze.
whatItIs: Mì xào hải sản is wok-fried egg noodles with seafood such as shrimp, squid, or fish cake, plus vegetables and garlic. It should taste briny, hot, and a little smoky from the pan.
howToEnjoy: Eat it soon after it lands so the noodles keep their chew and the seafood stays tender. Ask about shellfish before ordering if allergies matter.
howLocalsOrder: Order mì xào hải sản for a seafood noodle plate rather than soup. Ask for less spice, less oil, or no shellfish if you need less chili, less oil, or no shellfish.
worthKnowing: At casual shops, hải sản can mean a mix of shrimp, squid, fish cake, or whatever seafood the kitchen has ready.
goodToKnow: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
travelerCaution: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
